name: 100 Cats Lost In Space Find & Color
detailed_description:
Explore the cosmos and find over 1,000 hidden cats in 100 Cats Lost In Space: Find & Color!
Journey through more than 10 unique, hand-drawn space maps—from swirling nebulae to alien planets and space stations. Each scene is packed with playful cats cleverly hidden for you to discover.

Choose how to bring these scenes to life: follow the guided color-by-numbers mode for a relaxing, easy experience, or grab your full palette and color freely to express your creativity.

Play solo or join a friend in local co-op mode for double the fun as you hunt for cats together across the galaxy.

Perfect for cat lovers and coloring fans seeking a cosmic, soothing adventure.
